kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller
DELETE cleanup error is swallowed silently with .catch(() => {}), risking orphaned server-side files if the delete fails during CORS fallback
load() catches listAttachments errors silently, showing empty list without reporting the failure to user
header() function swallows errors from header getter silently without logging or documentation
sanitizeEventProperties() swallows errors from property descriptor access silently
Empty catch block swallows errors silently without logging or instrumentation.
ms.id.slice(3) assumes id exists and is a string with at least 3 characters without validation
Empty catch block silently swallows telemetry errors without logging or observability
